text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During training, Vivlos suddenly 
collapses. Dark clouds loom over her 
expedition to Dubai, and the decision on 
whether she can go is left riding on the 
outcome of her next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, her older sister, Cheval Grand, 
was also struggling after failing to 
produce results in her races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, when her Trainer took her out 
to relax, Vivlos reiterated her strong 
desire to race in Dubai and asserted that 
she had no regrets about running the Tiara 
route.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While keeping a concerned eye on the 
still-struggling Cheval Grand, Vivlos was 
able to steel her resolve for the Nakayama 
Kinen.
